description: This Java source file defines the NoteEditor class for an Android application, allowing users to view, create, edit, and delete notes within a Notepad app. It includes custom UI components, such as LinedEditText, handles various Activity lifecycle events, manages note data via a content provider, and supports clipboard operations and menu options.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: Main activity class for editing, creating, and deleting notes with lifecycle management and menu options.

classes.name: LinedEditText
classes.description: Custom EditText view that draws lines between each line of text for better readability.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up intent handling for editing or inserting notes, and binds UI elements.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the original content state before activity destruction.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Placeholder for pause state handling; currently, no custom logic.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Saves or deletes notes based on activity state when stopping.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates options menu and adds additional intent-based options.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items based on note state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user menu actions: save, delete, revert.

methods.name: performPaste
methods.description: Handles pasting note data from the clipboard, either as a URI reference or plain text.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the note content in the provider with new text and optional title.

methods.name: cancelNote
methods.description: Reverts changes or deletes a newly inserted note when canceled.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note from content provider.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader for asynchronously loading note data.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Populates UI with loaded note data and sets activity title.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles loader reset; no specific logic implemented.
